title: Snowball Fight — Compound Word Game

overview.description: A 'Snowball Fight' themed compound word game. From the filename: compound word practice through a physical/interactive game mechanic (snowball fight = crumple paper into balls, throw, open, read, match). Two compound word game drops in a row from Aless signals this is a skill she's specifically targeting. Link expired before download — reference from filename.

snowballFightMechanic.description: Likely format: each student writes/receives a word on paper, crumples it into a 'snowball,' throws it across the room, picks up someone else's snowball, opens it, and finds their match. The physical throwing + movement + reading creates a high-energy game from a literacy skill.
snowballFightMechanic.value: Kinesthetic learners get to MOVE. The game creates urgency and excitement around what would otherwise be a matching worksheet.

notes: Second compound word game drop in a row (after 'I Have Who Has'). Link expired. Aless is clearly targeting compound words as a specific skill AND showing multiple game formats for the same skill. The pattern: same skill (compound words) × different game mechanics (chain game, snowball fight) = multiple ways to practice. This is the same multi-modal approach she showed with the Harcourt alt teaching strategies (visual/kinesthetic/auditory).
